title: How does SunnySeat work?
summary: SunnySeat shows which outdoor seating areas appear to have direct sun right now.
model: We model sun position, building shadows, and weather for each place.
uncertainty: Trees, awnings, umbrellas, bridges, and temporary structures can affect real conditions on site.
guidance: Use the forecast as guidance when choosing where to sit.
heroAlt: Sunset over an outdoor terrace in Gothenburg
mapLegendIntro: Pins follow the selected time: right now by default, or the planner date and time you choose.
mapLegendSunnyBody: More than half of the seating area is in direct sun at the selected time and weather is not blocking it.
mapLegendShadedBody: Not sunny then: shade, low exposure, cloud, rain, or another obstruction.
mapLegendExample: 70% means roughly 70% of the seating area is sunny at the selected time - not a 70% chance that it is sunny.
algorithmBody: We calculate the sun's position in real time for your location and combine it with models of buildings and terrain to predict where the shadows fall. The weather forecast is then factored in, so a place under cloud is not counted as sunny.
sourceLantmaterietDesc: Building footprints and topography for the shadow calculation.
sourceGoteborgDesc: Open city geodata that helps us understand buildings and level changes.
sourceMetnoDesc: Weather forecasts for cloud and precipitation at each place.
sourceVenueFactsDesc: Opening hours and outdoor seating are sourced independently and manually reviewed.
sourceOsmDesc: Used only as a supplemental pilot when coverage and licence requirements are approved.
accuracyBody: The goal is for the sun figure to match what you find on site. When you answer "is this right?" after a visit, you help us find errors in geometry, weather, or place data and improve the model. The app may track internal confidence to prioritize fixes, but it is not shown as a separate number for a place.
contactBody: Have questions or suggestions? Leave feedback right in the app while viewing a place, and you help us get better.
